name: uwmd-monorepo
description: UW Markdown — open-source standard for underwriting documents.
//workspaces: `npm run build --workspaces` runs in this listed order (globs expand alphabetically). @uwmd/core depends on @uwmd/verify, and every other package depends on one or both, so uwmd-verify MUST stay pinned first and uwmd-core second or a clean checkout fails: uwmd-batch would build ahead of them and cannot resolve '@uwmd/verify', and uwmd-cli or uwmd-excel cannot resolve '@uwmd/core'. The trailing glob still picks up new packages automatically; npm de-duplicates the repeated paths.

scripts.test:coverage: npm --prefix packages/uwmd-verify run test:coverage && npm --prefix packages/uwmd-core run test:coverage
scripts.conformance: node --test scripts/conformance-targets.test.mjs scripts/standalone-kit.test.mjs conformance/metrics/verifier.test.mjs && node scripts/run-conformance.mjs
scripts.conformance:profiles: python3 -B -m unittest discover -s conformance/runner -p "test_*.py" && node scripts/check-conformance-profiles.mjs
scripts.verify-indexes: node --test scripts/docs-site-sources.test.mjs scripts/spec-refs.test.mjs scripts/agent-guidance.test.mjs scripts/public-identity.test.mjs && node scripts/verify-indexes.mjs
